html: † עַרְקִי adj.gent. Arḳite, inhabitant of city ʿArḳa (Assyrian Arḳa COTGloss. DlPa 282, TelAm. Irḳat(a), Egyptian Arḳantu, cf. Assyrian n.gent. Irḳanatai COTGloss., Ency. Bib. i. 310);—only הָע׳ as n.coll. Gn 10:17, τὸν Ἀρουκαῖον, = 1 Ch 1:15, A id., 𝔊L τὸν Αρακει: mod. ʿArḳa, near Mediterranean, c. 60 miles N. of Beirut (cf. Ency. Bib.l.c.).
